dogecoin.text: my grandma asked me about buying dogecoin last week so for me it seems to have reached critical mass. She didn't know it by name but asked about a "bitcoin" that went from 20 cents to 60 cents one of her 60+ community friends bought

Not that doge won’t go higher, but did people think everyday moms and dads would rush on a computer, verify their ID on an exchange, buy Dogecoin and then hold it in the wee hours of the night following an SNL episode
